messages: The tracking page still says it’s on the way, but that hasn’t changed since Monday. Could you check where my package is?
I was expecting this a few days ago, and there’s still nothing at my door. Do you know when it might turn up?
My tracking hasn’t updated in over a week, and I’m starting to think the parcel got sent somewhere else. Can someone look into it?
The delivery date came and went, but I haven’t received anything. Is there any way to find out what happened?
I’ve checked with my neighbors and looked around the building, but no box has appeared. The tracking just says it’s moving through the network.
This was meant to arrive before the weekend, and it still hasn’t shown up. Could you tell me if it’s still coming?
I’m not sure what’s going on with this shipment—the tracking has been stuck at the same location for days. Please let me know if you can see more detail.
Nothing has arrived, even though the carrier marked the package as nearly here last week. Could it be delayed somewhere?
I’ve been waiting longer than expected and the tracking link isn’t giving me anything useful. Can you help me figure out where the parcel is?
The package hasn’t turned up, and the estimated delivery day was yesterday. Should I keep waiting, or does this need to be investigated?
I think my delivery may have gone missing somewhere along the way. There haven’t been any new tracking updates, and I still don’t have it.
Could you check on my shipment? It was supposed to be here already, but I haven’t seen it and the tracking hasn’t changed.
